required_strings.why: mirrors EveryShippedDescriptionNamesTheRangeTheCodeEnforces in rimworld-simple-improve/Tests/MaterialCostFieldTests.cs, which pins MaterialCostField.MinimumMultiplier and MaximumMultiplier over the ten shipped files. The selector reproduces that test's own `l.Contains(minimum) || l.Contains("5%")`, substring trap included: a bullet reading '25% faster' would be picked instead and fail both assertions.
